name: demo-video-recorder
description: Use when the user wants a demo, LinkedIn or product video of a web UI: zoom-ins on panels recorded with Playwright and an in-page CSS camera, a title card and captions burned from a story script anchored to UI events, sped-up waits, and a highlight reel cut from several clips; also captions a screen recording (.mov) the user made. Headless Linux, Playwright + ffmpeg, Korean fonts. Korean triggers: 데모 영상, 시연 영상, 링크드인 영상, 영상 녹화, 화면 녹화 편집, 자막 넣어줘, 하이라이트 릴, 릴 만들어줘.
